out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed containers of soybean oil stored directly on the floor next to a handwashing sink at the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC moved the containers of soybean oil to approved shelving units.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no bleach test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the bleach sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC purchased a bleach test kit during the inspection
